# V1.6 — Prod-flavor redeploy fix

**Status:** Done, committed `225103d`.

**What:** `IS_BETA_BUILD` flips to `true` on the `prod` flavor. Play Console's package-name lock forces internal testers onto the `prod` flavor too, not just `staging` — as a side effect, the Beta feedback row (gated on `IS_BETA_BUILD`, added in [V1.4 slice 8](v1.4.md)) was invisible to testers. `false` was correct for a genuine public launch, but testing is still happening exclusively on `prod` for now (see memory `staging-prod-environment`: prod Supabase doesn't exist yet, `prod` is temporarily backed by staging). Flip back to `false` right before the actual public production launch.

Also in this commit:
- `versionCode`/`versionName` bumped `1`/`"0.1.0"` → `2`/`"1.6.0"`, for the Play Console redeploy.
- `supabase/migrations/2026-07-04_backfill_stale_shared_goals.sql` — backfill for savings goals left stuck `is_shared=true` by the since-fixed `unpair()` gap (see the [V1.5 unpair() reconciliation saga](v1.5.md#the-unpair-reconciliation-saga-2026-07-03--read-before-touching-unpair)).

This surfaced immediately after the [V1.5 post-ship audit](v1.5-post-ship-audit.md) closed out — no new bug-tracker items, just a redeploy blocker found by Alvin testing the live internal-testing build.

Next up: [V1.6.1](v1.6.1.md) (in progress — Item 4 done, rest planned).
